info.description: crun.ai Google Veo 3.1 Fast API Documentation

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description:
All APIs require authentication via API Key.

Get API Key:
1. Visit [API Key Management Page](https://crun.ai/user-api-key) to get your API Key

Usage:
Add to request header:

x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY

Note:
- Keep your API Key secure and do not share it with others
- If you suspect your API Key has been compromised, reset it immediately in the management page

code.description:
Response status code

- **200**: Success - Request has been processed successfully
- **401**: Unauthorized - Authentication credentials are missing or invalid
- **402**: Insufficient Credits - Account does not have enough credits to perform the operation
- **404**: Not Found - The requested resource or endpoint does not exist
- **422**: Validation Error - The request parameters failed validation checks
- **429**: Rate Limited - Request limit has been exceeded for this resource
- **455**: Service Unavailable - System is currently undergoing maintenance
- **500**: Server Error - An unexpected error occurred while processing the request
- **501**: Generation Failed - Content generation task failed
- **505**: Feature Disabled - The requested feature is currently disabled

message.description: Response message, error description when failed

post.summary: Generate video using google veo3.1 fast

model.description:
The model name to use for generation. Required field.

- Must be `google/veo3-1-fast-t2v` for this endpoint

callback_url.description:
Optional. Callback URL for receiving task completion notifications.

- System will POST task status and results to this URL when generation completes
- Callback payloads structure is consistent with the `data` object returned by the task status query
- Your callback endpoint should accept POST requests with JSON payload containing results
- It returns an HTTP 200 status code upon successful receipt

input.description: Input parameters for the text-to-video generation task

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video content
prompt.example: A cinematic aerial shot of a futuristic city at sunset, with flying vehicles and glowing skyscrapers.

duration.description: Video duration in seconds. This model supports 4, 6, or 8 seconds.

resolution.description: Output video resolution. Higher resolutions may increase generation latency and credit usage.

translate_prompt.description: Whether to automatically translate the prompt into the model's preferred language

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio of the output video
